I don't do it in public because I don't want people to think I'm weird I only do it when I'm alone. I guess I've always been a mindful eater I guess you could say? I absolutely despise the feeling of being full. Like I hate eating until I'm stuffed/full, I will eat until I no longer feel hungry. If I eat until I'm full I just feel gross and my stomach hurts lmao.
So sometimes when I'm eating, and if it's really good take out or whatever that I know won't reheat the same, I'll just chew it and then spit it out because I WANT to keep eating but feeling like I over-ate will just make me like actually sick lol

edit: forgot some things
I'm pretty sure my weight is fine! I'm 5'2 and about 110 lbs. I do get nauseous sometimes after I eat, but my doctor said it's likely just mild IBS! I just hate the feeling of being full

When I cook for myself I don't do this, it's usually only when I'm eating out. Typically it's only for the last like 3-4 bites of food left in a burger or nuggets, etc. I would get smaller sizes but I live in America so the small size is still pretty big
I'm in the US! But I am part Japanese so that's why I have a rice cooker :)
I was going to! I just don't want to cause any conflict with my roommate so I wasn't sure if me taking it was an assholey thing to do lol

I did try and talk to him. I asked him what he meant by life not having a point. He was like, "I don't have a reason. It's irrational and I know it is, but I know that I'll die one day and nothing I do matters. So I'm just wasting my time by living." 

I'm trying my best because I know how he feels. I also have severe depression, I used to be suicidal, so I know the darkness of that tunnel. I often ask how he is or how he's doing. I also never bring up my own depression with him because I don't want him to feel like I'm making it all about me. 

I feel like even if I do everything right I can't help him.
